correctness.rationale: The 125 word alphabet is (Z/5)^3 and pair compatibility requires cyclic coordinate difference of 2 in at least one position. Fixing 000 by translation leaves exactly 98 compatible candidates. An independently written bitset exact branch-and-bound C++17 clique search (greedy proper graph-color pruning and unique branching) exhaustively finds 31,328 size-9 cliques on these candidates and no size-10 clique, proving alpha(C5 strong-power 3)=10. Translation double counting gives total 125*31328/10=391600 maximum labeled codes. Independent anchor/reflection/coordinate-permutation normalization finds exactly 85 natural isometry orbits, and orbit-size/stabilizer calculation yields histogram 1:53,2:19,3:2,4:7,8:1,10:2,40:1 with sum 391600. The fixed finite census is justified exhaustive enumeration, not random sampling; the generated C++ program was independently run and matched the source package ORBITS.csv.
